records.original_message: Урежь обший бюджет на 20 тысяч рублей и напомни теперь возраста обоих детей.
Вылет лучше рано утрам. На какое число у меня сейчас выезд из отеля?

fixes.actual_failure: Before 15000000 minor RUB, explicit reduction of 20 thousand; raw and checked amounts were 14800000, so the canonical reply wrongly reported 148000 RUB.
fixes.code: Recognize the exact modifier typo обший only between a budget command and its budget. Add уреж as an explicit budget command. Ground the current whole-trip RUB base minus the explicit literal: 15000000-2000000=13000000.
fixes.ambiguous_relative: A schema-valid positive proposed budget with an explicit relative-budget verb but unbound direction is suppressed with a question. Invalid/negative proposals remain for normal validation; old oracles were unchanged.
fixes.preserved: Children ages5/9 and other operations/facts are unchanged. No new budget intent is initiated.

fixes.actual_failure: A fresh owned checkout question received 10 ноября 2026 года выезжаем. The model omitted the date and added an unrequested nonstop=false which the old guard removed. Checkout stayed missing.
fixes.source_spacing: The actual source has a space between month and year. Glued ноября2026 is a separately labelled controlled variant.
fixes.code: Accept only a whole absolute calendar answer under the fresh owned slot; the suffix выезжаем/выезжаю belongs only to checkout. Normalize month/year spacing without guessing a year.
fixes.ownership: Stale/foreign/other field/pause/question/hypothesis/quote/compound/flight-verb cases do not apply dates. No text before the first date is discarded.
fixes.verified_result: The current turn sets 2026-11-10 and the return leg immediately, with no additional model call or later budget message.

fixes.actual_failure: The model supplied early_morning and the correct checkout date. The preference guard stripped рано утрам and the reply became a generic no-change notice.
fixes.code: Accept рано утрам only with a positive flight/departure cue; arrival/wakeup/history/hypothesis/quote/negation do not authorize the new typo.
fixes.parent_hook: Root extends canonical changed_trip_receipt to a validated no-op set_preference plus a saved-fact question. It uses current facts, not model prose.
fixes.negative_canary: The controlled PG model reply deliberately says 01.01.2099. Both the changed preference and known no-op reply contain canonical 15.11.2026 and exclude2099.

verification.ruff: PASS for three assigned source files and two new test files

historical_tests.cause: One old scalar-guard fixture proposes invalid negative budget -999. New suppression was restricted to schema-valid positive proposals, restoring normal-validator authority without changing that oracle.

causes: Real no-op canonical-date reply loss, fixed by the Root reply hook.

A new test incorrectly prohibited all tool starts after a changed flight preference. Bounded controlled re-search is legitimate. Only that assumption was removed; canonical date, state and order checks remain strict.

scope_limits: Controlled raw-contract/API/PG evidence is not a fresh strong-model replay. Original actual failures remain immutable.
Money typo scope is the exact same-budget modifier, not arbitrary fuzzy monetary speech or unknown-scope arithmetic.
The date extension addresses a fresh owned checkout token. A freeform invalid-date edit without pending, such as actual017 November31→December1, is an independent Root finding and is not closed here.
A changed preference may trigger bounded controlled re-search. These PG tests do not prove real source availability.
Full80/106 acceptance remains separate. Parent owns the combined frozen-source full suite and actual retest.
